scope.generation_policy: M8-01 records source and derived-consumer ownership only. M8-02 and M8-03 author reader content; M8-04 is the only task that refreshes maps, manifests, search, help targets, or approved screenshots. Generated output is never hand-edited.

delivered_behaviors.required_reader_boundary: Describe all four supported artifacts, state that ESR 115 serves organizations with legacy systems without extending operating-system vendor support, and direct selection before validation, editing, import, or export.
Use the lifecycle catalog and policy-disposition audit for exact availability; do not infer policy support from a channel label or treat independently generated ESR artifacts as aliases.
State the actual per-channel generated-layer availability and retain the existing no-certification, no-endorsement, and manual-review boundaries.
Explain selection, read-only preview, blocker result, explicit confirmation, atomic apply, and no-silent-loss behavior without exposing plan digests, raw policy values, or internal recipe details.

An active saved ESR 115 or ESR 140 profile can be recommended to ESR 153; recommendation and opening preview do not write, and Release/latest/unknown/retired/inactive profiles do not receive an invented action.

Document only the shipped preview/apply operations and exact policies.json envelopes; preview is read-only and apply requires the current reviewed revision, while locale-neutral error codes are not localized prose.

A supported older ESR is not migrated automatically. Only an actual future retirement can use its declared immediate successor through a backup-gated Alembic upgrade; the current ESR 140 candidate materializer is not an operator action.

Blocked, stale, invalid, and failed manual conversion leaves the profile unchanged and needs a fresh preview; interrupted or partial retired-ESR migration requires verified-backup recovery in a new clean candidate, never in-place repair or downgrade.
